fixtures.notes: Required baseline. v0.9.3 writes data.db at schema version 11 and has no det-<network>.sqlite, so it always upgrades through the legacy drain rather than the platform_compatibility bridge (structurally immune to the platform-wallet-storage DivergentVersion class of bug — see the approved plan). It predates DASH_EVO_DATA_DIR, det-cli and the SPV stack, hence XDG_CONFIG_HOME isolation and a GUI capture.
fixtures.known_limitations: Profile is wallet-only, NOT wallet-identity-dpns, despite an identity being genuinely registered on testnet for this fixture wallet. A Platform identity (51iVVoMU8ANbxDv7wySh5Sk6mZGSEMpCkeqtkr24mHdE) and DPNS name (migtestfixture093.dash) were registered on testnet using the current build (commit 9cbf464f3) specifically for this capture, but v0.9.3's SDK cannot load ANY identity from the current testnet: its GroveDB proof-verification code only understands proof variant 0, while current testnet nodes return variant 1 ('Proof verification error: ... UnexpectedVariant { allowed: Range { min: 0, max: 0 }, found: 1 }'). This is a permanent client/network protocol incompatibility, not a config or timing issue, and blocks EVERY identity load attempt from v0.9.3 against today's testnet, not just this one. data.db's identity table therefore has 0 rows in this fixture. The on-chain identity+DPNS registration remains independently verifiable and reusable (e.g. to test 'does a newer build see an identity that existed before the fixture's wallet was captured', which does not require v0.9.3 itself to render it) but this fixture cannot be used to assert 'identity/DPNS data survives a v0.9.3 upgrade' end-to-end. Also note: v0.9.3's own .env.example ships a dead TESTNET_dapi_addresses list (all 18 addresses unreachable); the packed .env has that one value replaced with the current fixed address list so the app can reach DAPI at all, everything else left at v0.9.3's original format.
